text:
sahil: Heads-up — spotted a staging slot conflict for the marketplace microsite on staging-3. HW partner hero deploy is scheduled same window as marketplace listing cutover. Need quick tradeoff call.

maria: ugh. which window? I only have the press slot at 17:30 PT noted.

sahil: window is 00:30 UTC on 2026-04-02 (that's 17:30 PT). HW team asked for hero swap + cert banner at that time.

jen: if press is fixed we should move the partner hero or shift the listing cutover by 30m. which is easier infra-wise @kevin?

kevin: shifting listing by 30m is ok but will require a CDN purge afterwards. not ideal for live traffic. moving partner hero is simpler.

maria: partner requests that hero goes live alongside their joint blog publish — sync between blog and hero is important for them.

tao: can we do a staged hero deploy? hero assets live but hidden flag until blog publish trigger? we have a toggle in console.

jen: yes — toggle approach works. ops can flip at publish, so no deploy-time collision.

kevin: confirmed toggle exists. ops team will need the exact asset path and tracking params to preview. ask HW partner to upload final hero to s3://redwood-marketplace/hw/partnerX/v3/ — screenshot required.

nina: pinged partner for final hero and tracking tag. also flagged SI integration docs — their pre-cert checklist still missing step 4 (network egress rules). partner said they'd push today.

maria: press embargo still holds at 17:30 PT? we can't flip toggle before embargo lifts.

sahil: correct, embargo 17:30 PT. plan: assets uploaded by 15:00 PT, ops preview at 16:00 PT, toggle flip at 17:30 PT.

launchbot: reminder created: deploy-preview @ 16:00 PT, toggle-flip @ 17:30 PT, postmortem checklist attached.

tao: SI certification note — once partner completes network step we need a quick smoke test: run curl to health endpoint from SI subnet and verify token exchange. snippet for SI: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://si.example.com/health | jq .status`

kevin: ops will run smoke test after toggle flip too, just in case. also scheduling CDN purge window 10m after flip to avoid stale content.

maria: marketing will hold the blog ready and keep the embargo cron in place. can someone confirm analytics UTM and partner promo code? need final strings.

nina: partner confirmed utm_source=partnerX&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch and promo=PARTNERX20. adding to the assets doc.

jen: ok owners: assets (nina), ops (kevin/tao), press (maria), partner comms (sahil). agenda for 16:00 preview: asset visual, toggle preview, smoke test dry-run, legal final line on partner crediting.

sahil: quick checklist for today (copying into thread):
```
- 15:00 PT: partner uploads final hero + screenshots
- 16:00 PT: ops preview on staging-3 (toggle enabled for preview)
- 17:00 PT: legal signoff on crediting copy
- 17:30 PT: embargo lift -> toggle flip -> blog publish
- 17:40 PT: CDN purge (10m) -> verify analytics events
- 18:00 PT: post-launch verification & SI smoke test
```

maria: looks good. I'll be on standby at preview and flip. will confirm PR for blog at 16:30.

kevin: ops will be in #release-war-room during preview and flip. tagging on-call infra.

nina: partner just uploaded hero v3 and sitemap update. sharing preview link: https://staging-3.redwood.ai/partnerX-hero-preview

tao: saw the preview — mobile image needs crop tweak. flagged with partner.

partner-bot: asset-upload event: partnerX/hero-v3 uploaded by partnerX_user at 15:07 PT.

sahil: perfect. last-mile note: because we used toggle approach, we avoid the staging slot conflict. closing loop — move HW hero deploy to 18:00 PT fallback if any blocker.

jen: thanks everyone. I'll run the legal crediting check at 17:00 and post here.

maria: closing loop too — blog PR merged and scheduled to publish on toggle flip. :tada: 

kevin: ops done — staging preview ok. will coordinate purge timing with CDN.

sahil: resolved for now. reopening only if partner assets or SI checklist lags. good job team :thumbsup:
